messages:
ajay: Heads up — partner marketplace images (edge-cloud vendor) started failing healthchecks after NVIDIA driver 535.86 got pinned in our marketplace AMI. Errors on container startup: `libcuda.so: cannot open shared object file`. Rolling back to 535.54 fixed it locally.

maria: Oof. Which workloads are failing? The partner's alert shows failures in the tokenization service + quantized runtime.

ajay: Quick triage: RTX A100 nodes with CUDA 12.2 + driver 535.86. Runtime stack uses a couple custom int8 kernels. Crash snippet from their node: 
```
error: failed to load CUDA kernels: cuInit(0) -> 999
# dlopen: libcuda.so: undefined symbol: cuMemAllocAsync
```

sarah: Is this the same flaky segfault CI flagged last week for CUDA 12.2?

kevin: Not identical. This looks driver-side: missing ABI symbol when users hit an older kernel/nvidia module combo. Vendor images were built against a different libcuda ABI.

partner-eng-jp: Confirming: partner's hypervisor image pins kernel modules for stability; they can't upgrade kernel rapidly. Their gating rejected 535.86 because module signatures mismatch.

ajay: Proposed short-term plan: pin marketplace AMIs to driver 535.54 and add a compatibility fallback in the marketplace manifest so clusters that declare kernel>=5.15 can opt into 535.86. I suggest a manifest change: add `driver_pin` and `driver_fallbacks` fields to the AMI descriptor.

maria: +1. We also need a hotfix AMI and clear release notes for partners. Can we create a signed shim to detect kernel+module mismatch and fall back to vendor driver path?

sarah: Ops — can we run a canary in partner staging? I'll schedule a 10% canary (traffic + provisioning) window.

deploy-bot: deploy request created: `canary/staging -> marketplace-edge/ami` (driver_pin:535.54). PR: https://git.internal/r/1234

kevin: I'll prepare a rollback runbook and a kernel compatibility matrix. Looping in ROCm eng to confirm there are no parallel regressions on AMD stacks.

partner-eng-jp: Partner also asked for explicit notes about kernel-module signing and HSM key requirements for enterprise customers — they'll need wording for compliance teams.

ajay: Timeline: ship hotfix AMI + manifest by EOD PDT, run canary for 2h, then full rollout if green. If canary fails, rollback manifest and escalate. @sarah please run the smoke suite: `tests/smoke/launch_and_infer.py --model=gpt-mini`.

maria: I'll draft partner-facing comms with reproducer steps + logs and cc legal for marketplace contract notice.

kevin: Logging checklist for runbook: collect `dmesg`, `/var/log/nvidia-installer.log`, `rd-client` logs, and the container runtime stderr. Add sample `gcore` capture steps.

ajay: Thanks. I'll post a rollup to #marketplace-status after canary. :thumbsup:

sarah: Canary started 12:20 PDT.

deploy-bot: canary success after 2h. 200/200 checks green.

ajay: Rolling to prod now.

maria: Partner comms sent (includes reproducer, AMI ID, and mitigation guidance).

kevin: Rollout complete — metrics look stable. Closing thread.
